title: Telegram Bot
subtitle: Connect your Telegram bot to receive real-time order and payment notifications directly in your groups or channels.
card1Title: Link Your Shop to a Telegram Chat
card1Desc: The shop bot receives order & payment notifications in any chat that links to this shop.
howToLinkTitle: How to link your group (3 steps):
step1: Add the bot to your group from Telegram:
step1SaveFirst: save the Bot Token below first, then refresh
step2: In that group, press Start (or send /start).
step3: Send the command below in the group (or copy it):
profileIdNotSet: Profile ID / Secret Key will appear here once the bot token is saved.
webhookSuccess: Webhook registered! You can now /start the bot and LINK this shop.
webhookHelp: Required before any chat can link. Press it again after any update to re-register (also enables the bot to auto-reply with LINK instructions when added to a group).
noLinkedChats: No chats linked yet. Follow the steps above to link the first one.
card2Desc: Receive automatic notifications when a customer places an order or pays successfully. Create a bot with @BotFather and add it to your group to get the chat ID.
botTokenHelp: Create your bot with @BotFather, then paste its token here. Tokens are stored per-shop on the server.
chatIdHelp: Negative IDs are supergroups; private chats use positive IDs.
enableNotificationsDesc: When turned on, the system sends instant alerts for every store activity.
testSuccess: Test notification sent! Check your Telegram chat.
whatGetsSent1: New order notification when a customer checks out.
whatGetsSent2: Payment-success notification (with order number, amount, customer) once ABA Pay confirms.
botFatherHelpDesc: Quick guide to generate your own Telegram bot token in 30 seconds:
botFatherStep2: Send /newbot and choose a display name & username ending with 'bot'
botFatherStep3: Copy the provided HTTP API token and paste it into the Bot Token field
missingConfigWarning: Enter Bot Token and at least one Chat ID to send test alerts
